senses.en: to spend less money or use fewer resources; to save

ex.en: We need to economize on electricity during the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天我們需要節約用電。

root.note: 好好管理家務開支 → 節約

senses.en: an overwhelming feeling of great happiness

ex.en: The fans screamed in ecstasy when the band appeared on stage.
ex.zh: 樂團一登台，歌迷們便欣喜若狂地尖叫。

root.note: 站到自己之外（靈魂出竅）→ 狂喜

senses.en: feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness

ex.en: She was ecstatic when she got into her dream university.
ex.zh: 她被夢想中的大學錄取時欣喜若狂。

root.note: 站到自己之外 → 狂喜的

senses.en: fit or safe to be eaten

ex.en: Not every wild mushroom is edible, so be careful.
ex.zh: 並非所有野生菇類都能吃，要小心。

root.note: 能吃的

senses.en: an official order issued by a person in authority

ex.en: The king issued an edict banning all public gatherings.
ex.zh: 國王頒布法令，禁止一切公開集會。

root.note: 說出來的（命令）→ 法令

senses.en: to instruct or improve someone morally or intellectually

ex.en: The museum aims to edify as well as entertain its visitors.
ex.zh: 這間博物館的目標是在娛樂參觀者的同時也給予啟發。

root.note: 建造（品格）→ 教化

mn: edifice（大廈）和 edify（建造心靈）同字根。

senses.en: a newspaper article expressing the editors' opinion
relating to editing or editors

ex.en: The newspaper ran an editorial criticizing the new tax.
ex.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇批評新稅制的社論。

root.note: 編輯的（意見）→ 社論

senses.en: to bring out or develop something latent; to infer

ex.en: A good teacher can educe talents that students did not know they had.
ex.zh: 好老師能引出學生自己都不知道的才能。

root.note: 引導出來 → 引出

senses.en: to erase a mark from a surface
to make oneself appear unimportant (efface oneself)

ex.en: Time and weather had begun to efface the words on the old gravestone.
ex.zh: 歲月與風雨已開始磨去舊墓碑上的字跡。

root.note: 把臉（表面）抹去 → 擦掉

senses.en: a change that results from an action or cause
to bring about or cause to happen

ex.en: The medicine had an immediate effect on her headache.
ex.zh: 這藥對她的頭痛立即見效。

root.note: 做出來的東西 → 結果、效果

mn: affect 通常是動詞（影響）；effect 通常是名詞（效果），當動詞時是「造成、實現」。

senses.en: successful in producing a desired result
(of a law or rule) in operation

ex.en: Regular exercise is an effective way to reduce stress.
ex.zh: 規律運動是紓解壓力的有效方法。

root.note: 能做出結果的 → 有效的

senses.en: successful in producing the intended result

ex.en: The treaty proved an effectual means of keeping peace.
ex.zh: 事實證明這項條約是維持和平的有效手段。

root.note: 能做出結果的 → 有效的

mn: 反義詞 ineffectual（無能的、無效的）比 effectual 更常見。

senses.en: (of a man) the quality of having traits traditionally seen as feminine

ex.en: Older critics mocked the poet's supposed effeminacy.
ex.zh: 老一輩的評論家嘲笑這位詩人所謂的女子氣。

root.note: 變得像女人 → 女子氣

senses.en: (of a man) having traits traditionally seen as feminine, often used disapprovingly
senses.zh: （男子）娘娘腔的；女子氣的（多含貶義）

ex.en: In the old film, the villain mocks the hero as weak and effeminate.
ex.zh: 在那部老電影裡，反派嘲笑男主角軟弱又娘娘腔。

root.note: 變得像女人的 → 女子氣的

senses.en: to give off bubbles; to fizz
to be lively and enthusiastic

ex.en: Drop the tablet in water and watch it effervesce.
ex.zh: 把藥片丟進水裡，看它冒泡。

root.note: 沸騰冒出 → 冒泡

senses.en: (of a liquid) giving off bubbles
lively and enthusiastic

ex.en: Her effervescent personality made her popular with everyone.
ex.zh: 她活潑開朗的個性讓她人緣很好。

root.note: 沸騰冒泡的 → 活潑的

senses.en: weak and ineffective, especially from over-refinement
no longer capable of producing; worn out

ex.en: The effete aristocracy could no longer govern the country.
ex.zh: 那衰敗無能的貴族階層已無法治理國家。

root.note: 生育殆盡 → 衰竭的

senses.en: successful in producing the desired result; effective

ex.en: Rest proved more efficacious than any medicine for his injury.
ex.zh: 對他的傷來說，休息比任何藥都有效。

root.note: 能做出結果的 → 有效的

senses.en: the ability to produce a desired result

ex.en: Researchers are testing the efficacy of the new vaccine.
ex.zh: 研究人員正在測試新疫苗的效力。

root.note: 做出結果的能力 → 功效

senses.en: the ability to achieve maximum results with minimum waste

ex.en: The new software improved the efficiency of the whole office.
ex.zh: 新軟體提升了整個辦公室的效率。

root.note: 做事出成果的程度 → 效率

senses.en: working well with little waste of time or energy

ex.en: LED bulbs are far more efficient than old light bulbs.
ex.zh: LED 燈泡比舊式燈泡節能得多。

root.note: 能做出成果的 → 有效率的

mn: effective 重「有效果」，efficient 重「效率高、不浪費」。

senses.en: the most developed stage; a flowering
(chemistry) a powdery deposit on a surface

ex.en: The Renaissance was an efflorescence of art and science.
ex.zh: 文藝復興是藝術與科學的全盛時期。

root.note: 開出花來 → 開花、鼎盛

senses.en: blossoming; flourishing
(chemistry) forming a powdery crust

ex.en: The efflorescent city attracted artists from all over Europe.
ex.zh: 這座繁盛的城市吸引了來自歐洲各地的藝術家。

root.note: 正在開花的 → 繁盛的

senses.en: an unpleasant or harmful smell or discharge

ex.en: A foul effluvium rose from the polluted river.
ex.zh: 遭汙染的河流散發出一股惡臭。

root.note: 流出來的東西 → 臭氣

senses.en: shameless boldness; insolent nerve

ex.en: He had the effrontery to ask for a raise after missing a week of work.
ex.zh: 他曠職一週後竟厚著臉皮要求加薪。

root.note: 不知羞恥地把臉伸出來 → 厚顏無恥

senses.en: a brilliant radiance; shining brightness

ex.en: The effulgence of the rising sun filled the valley.
ex.zh: 旭日的光輝灑滿了山谷。

root.note: 向外發光 → 光輝

senses.en: to pour out a liquid, light, or feeling

ex.en: The flowers effuse a sweet scent in the evening.
ex.zh: 這些花在傍晚散發出甜美的香氣。

root.note: 往外倒 → 流出

senses.en: an unrestrained outpouring of words or feelings
(medicine) an escape of fluid into a body cavity

ex.en: Her effusion of thanks embarrassed the shy volunteer.
ex.zh: 她滔滔不絕的感謝讓那位害羞的志工很不好意思。

root.note: 往外倒出 → 傾吐、流露

senses.en: the belief or practice of acting in one's own self-interest

ex.en: His egoism made him ignore the needs of his teammates.
ex.zh: 他的自我中心讓他忽略了隊友的需要。

root.note: 以我為主的主義 → 利己主義

mn: egoism 偏重「利己」；egotism 偏重「自負、老愛談自己」。

senses.en: a self-centered person who acts mainly in their own interest

ex.en: An egoist rarely considers how his choices affect others.
ex.zh: 利己主義者很少考慮自己的選擇會如何影響別人。

root.note: 以我為主的人 → 利己主義者

senses.en: an exaggerated sense of self-importance; conceit

ex.en: The actor's egotism made him difficult to work with.
ex.zh: 那位演員的自大使人難以與他共事。

root.note: 滿腦子只有我 → 自負

senses.en: a conceited person who talks mostly about themselves

ex.en: Only an egotist would talk about himself for the entire dinner.
ex.zh: 只有自大的人才會整頓晚餐都在談自己。

root.note: 滿腦子只有我的人 → 自負的人

senses.en: the act of going out; a way out; an exit

ex.en: The fire code requires a clear path of egress from every room.
ex.zh: 消防法規要求每個房間都要有暢通的出口通道。

root.note: 走出去 → 出口

senses.en: to force or throw something out
to force someone to leave a place
(of a pilot) to escape from an aircraft by a seat that shoots out

ex.en: The referee had to eject two players for fighting.
ex.zh: 裁判不得不將兩名打架的球員驅逐出場。

root.note: 丟出去 → 噴出、逐出

senses.en: (of time) to pass

ex.en: Several months will elapse before the results are announced.
ex.zh: 要過好幾個月結果才會公布。

root.note: （時間）悄悄滑走 → 流逝

senses.en: the ability to return to original shape after being stretched
(economics) how much demand or supply changes in response to price

ex.en: As we age, our skin loses some of its elasticity.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，皮膚會失去一些彈性。

parts.m: drive, push 推動（希臘文 elaunein）

root.note: 被推開後能彈回 → 彈性

senses.en: chemical decomposition produced by passing an electric current through a liquid
the removal of hair roots using an electric current

ex.en: Water can be split into hydrogen and oxygen by electrolysis.
ex.zh: 水可以透過電解分解成氫和氧。

root.note: 用電分解 → 電解

senses.en: a printing plate copy made by depositing metal on a mold by electrolysis

ex.en: Printers once used an electrotype to reproduce detailed engravings.
ex.zh: 印刷業者曾用電鑄版來複製精細的版畫。

root.note: 用電製成的印版 → 電鑄版

senses.en: a sad poem or song, especially one for someone who has died

ex.en: The poet wrote an elegy for his late friend.
ex.zh: 詩人為已故的朋友寫了一首輓歌。

root.note: 哀悼的歌 → 輓歌

senses.en: an essential part of something
a substance that cannot be broken down chemically
a situation in which one feels comfortable (in one's element)

ex.en: Trust is an essential element of any friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何友誼的基本要素。

mn: in one's element：如魚得水；the elements：惡劣天氣（風雨）。

senses.en: to draw out a response, answer, or fact from someone

ex.en: The teacher asked questions to elicit ideas from the quiet students.
ex.zh: 老師透過提問引導安靜的學生說出想法。

root.note: 誘引出來 → 引出

mn: elicit（引出）和 illicit（非法的）發音相近，別搞混。

senses.en: meeting the conditions to do or receive something
(of a person) desirable as a marriage partner

ex.en: Students with good grades are eligible for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 成績好的學生有資格申請這項獎學金。

root.note: 能被選出來的 → 有資格的

senses.en: to completely remove or get rid of
to exclude from a competition by defeat

ex.en: The new system will eliminate the need for paper forms.
ex.zh: 新系統將不再需要紙本表格。

root.note: 趕出門檻外 → 排除

senses.en: relating to the reign of Queen Elizabeth I of England (1558–1603)
a person, especially a writer, of that period
senses.zh: 伊莉莎白時代的人（作家）

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote many plays for the Elizabethan stage.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞為伊莉莎白時代的舞台寫了許多劇作。

root.note: 伊莉莎白女王時代的

senses.en: the skill of clear and expressive speech

ex.en: She took lessons in elocution to improve her public speaking.
ex.zh: 她上了朗誦課來提升公開演講能力。

root.note: 把話說出來的技巧 → 演說術

senses.en: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
clearly expressive of a feeling

ex.en: Her eloquent speech moved the entire audience.
ex.zh: 她雄辯的演說感動了全場觀眾。

root.note: 很會把話說出來的 → 雄辯的

senses.en: to make something clear; to explain

ex.en: Could you elucidate what you meant by that remark?
ex.zh: 你能解釋一下那句話是什麼意思嗎？

root.note: 使清楚明亮 → 闡明

senses.en: to escape from or avoid, especially cleverly
to fail to be understood or achieved by someone

ex.en: The name of the song continues to elude me.
ex.zh: 我一直想不起那首歌的名字。

root.note: 玩弄一番後溜出去 → 躲避

mn: elude（躲避）vs. allude（暗指）vs. delude（欺騙）。

senses.en: the act of escaping or evading

ex.en: The fox's clever elusion of the hunters became a local legend.
ex.zh: 那隻狐狸巧妙躲過獵人的故事成了當地傳說。

root.note: 溜走 → 逃避

senses.en: to make abnormally thin and weak

ex.en: Long illness can emaciate even a strong person.
ex.zh: 長期患病可能讓身強體壯的人也變得骨瘦如柴。

root.note: 使變得非常瘦 → 使消瘦

mn: 形容詞 emaciated（骨瘦如柴的）比動詞更常用。

senses.en: to issue or spread out from a source

ex.en: A delicious smell began to emanate from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房開始飄出誘人的香味。

root.note: 流出來 → 散發

senses.en: to set free from legal, social, or political restrictions

ex.en: Education can emancipate people from poverty.
ex.zh: 教育能使人擺脫貧窮。

root.note: 從（主人）手中拿出來 → 解放

senses.en: an official ban on trade with a particular country
to officially ban trade in goods

ex.en: The United Nations imposed an arms embargo on the country.
ex.zh: 聯合國對該國實施武器禁運。

root.note: 用障礙擋在裡面 → 禁運

senses.en: to go on board a ship or aircraft
to begin a new project or course of action (embark on)

ex.en: After graduation, she will embark on a career in medicine.
ex.zh: 畢業後，她將展開醫學生涯。

root.note: 進入船中 → 上船；開始旅程

senses.en: to make someone feel awkward or ashamed

ex.en: Please do not embarrass me in front of my friends.
ex.zh: 拜託不要在我朋友面前讓我難堪。

root.note: 陷入障礙中 → 使尷尬

mn: 拼法兩個 r、兩個 s：embarrass。

senses.en: to make something more attractive by adding decorations
to add untrue details to a story to make it more interesting

ex.en: My uncle likes to embellish his fishing stories.
ex.zh: 我叔叔喜歡把他的釣魚故事加油添醋。

root.note: 使變美 → 裝飾、渲染

senses.en: to secretly steal money that one has been trusted to manage

ex.en: The accountant tried to embezzle funds from the charity.
ex.zh: 那名會計試圖侵吞慈善機構的資金。

parts.m: destroy, squander 破壞、揮霍（古法語）

root.note: 揮霍（別人的錢）→ 盜用

senses.en: to display a design or name prominently on something

ex.en: The team will emblazon its logo on every jersey.
ex.zh: 球隊會在每件球衣上印上醒目的隊徽。

root.note: 放上紋章 → 醒目地裝飾

senses.en: a design or symbol representing a group or idea

ex.en: The dove is a widely recognized emblem of peace.
ex.zh: 鴿子是廣為人知的和平象徵。

parts.m: throw, put 放（希臘文 ballein）

root.note: 鑲嵌放入的裝飾 → 徽章、象徵

senses.en: to be a clear, visible expression of an idea or quality
to include or contain as a part

ex.en: The young athlete seemed to embody the spirit of the Olympics.
ex.zh: 這位年輕運動員彷彿體現了奧運精神。

root.note: 放入身體 → 使具體化、體現

senses.en: to give someone the courage or confidence to do something

ex.en: The first victory may embolden the team to aim even higher.
ex.zh: 第一場勝利可能會讓隊伍更有信心挑戰更高目標。

root.note: 使變大膽

senses.en: the blocking of a blood vessel by a clot or air bubble

ex.en: A pulmonary embolism can be life-threatening if not treated quickly.
ex.zh: 肺栓塞若不及時治療可能危及生命。

root.note: 被丟進（血管）裡的東西 → 栓塞

senses.en: to involve someone deeply in a conflict or difficult situation

ex.en: The prince did not want to embroil his country in another war.
ex.zh: 王子不想讓他的國家捲入另一場戰爭。

root.note: 使陷入混亂 → 使捲入紛爭

senses.en: to move out of something and become visible
(of facts) to become known
to come through a difficult situation

ex.en: New evidence began to emerge during the investigation.
ex.zh: 調查期間，新證據開始浮現。

root.note: 從水中浮出 → 出現

senses.en: the process of coming into view or existence

ex.en: The emergence of smartphones changed how we communicate.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了我們溝通的方式。

root.note: 浮現 → 出現

senses.en: in the process of coming into being

ex.en: Many investors are interested in emergent technologies like quantum computing.
ex.zh: 許多投資人對量子運算等新興科技很有興趣。

root.note: 正在浮現的 → 新興的

senses.en: retired but keeping one's title as an honor

ex.en: She is now a professor emeritus of history at the university.
ex.zh: 她現在是該大學的歷史系榮譽退休教授。

root.note: 服務完畢、贏得（退休）→ 榮譽退休的

senses.en: a person who leaves their own country to live in another

ex.en: Each emigrant carried only one suitcase on the long voyage.
ex.zh: 每位移民在漫長的航程中只帶了一只行李箱。

root.note: 遷移出去的人 → 移出者

mn: emigrant 從原國「移出」；immigrant 是「移入」新國家的人。

senses.en: to leave one's own country to settle permanently in another

ex.en: His grandparents decided to emigrate to Canada in 1970.
ex.zh: 他的祖父母在 1970 年決定移民加拿大。

root.note: 遷移出去 → 移居國外

senses.en: fame or recognized superiority in a field
a piece of rising ground
a title for a cardinal (Your Eminence)

ex.en: She rose to eminence as one of the country's top surgeons.
ex.zh: 她成為全國頂尖的外科醫師之一而聲名顯赫。

root.note: 突出於眾人之上 → 卓越

mn: éminence grise（幕後掌權者）源自法文。

senses.en: famous and respected within a particular field
(of a quality) outstanding; notable

ex.en: An eminent scientist gave the opening lecture.
ex.zh: 一位傑出的科學家發表了開幕演講。

root.note: 突出的 → 傑出的

mn: eminent（傑出的）vs. imminent（即將發生的）vs. immanent（內在的）。

senses.en: to produce and send out light, heat, gas, or sound

ex.en: Electric cars emit far less pollution than gasoline cars.
ex.zh: 電動車排放的汙染遠少於汽油車。

root.note: 送出去 → 發出、排放

senses.en: special importance given to something
stress placed on a word or syllable in speaking

ex.en: Our school places great emphasis on reading.
ex.zh: 我們學校非常重視閱讀。

root.note: 把內在顯示出來 → 強調

senses.en: to give special importance to something

ex.en: The coach wanted to emphasize the importance of teamwork.
ex.zh: 教練想要強調團隊合作的重要性。

root.note: 把重點顯示出來 → 強調

senses.en: expressing something forcefully and clearly
clear and decisive

ex.en: Her answer was an emphatic "No!"
ex.zh: 她斬釘截鐵地回答：「不！」

root.note: 用力顯示出來的 → 強調的

senses.en: a person who works for another person or company for pay

ex.en: Every new employee must attend a safety training session.
ex.zh: 每位新員工都必須參加安全訓練課程。

root.note: 被雇用的人

senses.en: a person or company that pays people to work for them

ex.en: My employer offers free lunch on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我的雇主每週五提供免費午餐。

root.note: 雇用人的人 → 雇主

senses.en: a large store selling a wide variety of goods
a center of commerce; a marketplace

ex.en: The old emporium sold everything from hats to hardware.
ex.zh: 那家老百貨店從帽子到五金什麼都賣。

root.note: 商人聚集之處 → 商場

senses.en: to give someone the authority or power to do something
to make someone stronger and more confident

ex.en: The program aims to empower young women through education.
ex.zh: 這個計畫旨在透過教育增強年輕女性的能力。

root.note: 使有權力 → 授權

senses.en: to try to match or surpass someone, usually by imitation
(computing) to reproduce the function of another system

ex.en: Many young players try to emulate their favorite athletes.
ex.zh: 許多年輕球員試著仿效他們最喜愛的運動員。

root.note: 與人競爭而模仿 → 仿效

senses.en: to make a bill into law
to act out a role or play

ex.en: Congress voted to enact stricter gun laws.
ex.zh: 國會投票制定了更嚴格的槍枝法律。

root.note: 使成為法案 → 制定

senses.en: to fill with love or delight (usually passive: be enamored of/with)

ex.en: The city's charm is sure to enamor first-time visitors.
ex.zh: 這座城市的魅力必定會讓初次造訪的遊客著迷。

root.note: 使陷入愛中 → 使迷戀

mn: 常用 be enamored of/with：迷戀於…。

senses.en: to settle in or set up a camp

ex.en: The army will encamp by the river for the night.
ex.zh: 軍隊今晚將在河邊紮營。

root.note: 進入營地 → 紮營

senses.en: a speech or piece of writing that praises someone highly

ex.en: The retiring teacher received an encomium from her former students.
ex.zh: 這位退休老師收到以前學生獻上的讚辭。

parts.m: revel, celebration 慶典（希臘文 komos）

root.note: 慶典中的頌讚 → 讚詞

senses.en: to include a wide range of things
to surround and have within

ex.en: The course will encompass both ancient and modern history.
ex.zh: 這門課將涵蓋古代史與近代史。

root.note: 放入圓圈內 → 包含

senses.en: a repeated or extra performance at the audience's request
called out by an audience to request more

ex.en: The crowd cheered until the singer came back for an encore.
ex.zh: 觀眾不停歡呼，直到歌手回台上安可。

root.note: 再一次 → 加演

senses.en: to give support, confidence, or hope to someone
to help something develop

ex.en: Good teachers encourage students to ask questions.
ex.zh: 好老師會鼓勵學生發問。

root.note: 使有勇氣 → 鼓勵

senses.en: to gradually intrude on someone's territory, rights, or time

ex.en: New housing developments continue to encroach on farmland.
ex.zh: 新的住宅開發案持續侵占農地。

root.note: 用鉤子鉤進來 → 侵占

senses.en: to restrict or burden someone so that movement or action is difficult

ex.en: Heavy backpacks will encumber the hikers on the steep trail.
ex.zh: 沉重的背包會拖累健行者在陡峭山路上的行進。

root.note: 放入障礙中 → 妨礙

senses.en: a letter from the Pope sent to all bishops of the Roman Catholic Church

ex.en: The Pope's encyclical addressed climate change and the poor.
ex.zh: 教宗的通諭談到了氣候變遷與窮人的問題。

root.note: 在圈內傳閱的（信）→ 通諭

senses.en: a book or set of books giving information on many subjects

ex.en: Before the internet, we looked up facts in an encyclopedia.
ex.zh: 在網路出現之前，我們都查百科全書來找資料。

root.note: 全面性的教育 → 百科全書

senses.en: to put someone or something at risk

ex.en: Texting while driving can endanger lives.
ex.zh: 開車時傳訊息可能危及性命。

root.note: 使陷入危險

senses.en: to cause someone to be loved or liked

ex.en: His kindness to animals will endear him to the whole town.
ex.zh: 他對動物的善心會讓全鎮的人都喜歡他。

root.note: 使變得親愛 → 使受喜愛

senses.en: (of a disease) regularly found in a particular area or group
(of a plant or animal) native only to a certain place

ex.en: The Formosan black bear is endemic to Taiwan.
ex.zh: 台灣黑熊是台灣特有種。

root.note: 存在於本地人民之中的 → 地方性的

mn: endemic（地方性）vs. epidemic（流行性）vs. pandemic（全球大流行）。

senses.en: to provide someone with a quality or ability

ex.en: Nature seemed to endue her with a gift for music.
ex.zh: 上天似乎賦予了她音樂天分。

parts.m: lead, put on 引導、穿上（拉丁文 inducere）

root.note: 給人穿上（特質）→ 賦予

senses.en: able to be tolerated or endured

ex.en: A cool breeze made the summer heat more endurable.
ex.zh: 一陣涼風讓夏天的酷熱變得比較能忍受。

root.note: 能夠持久撐住的 → 可忍受的

senses.en: the ability to endure a difficult process without giving up

ex.en: Running a marathon requires great physical endurance.
ex.zh: 跑馬拉松需要很強的體力耐力。

root.note: 持久撐住 → 耐力

senses.en: showing or involving great activity or vitality

ex.en: The energetic puppy ran around the yard for hours.
ex.zh: 那隻精力旺盛的小狗在院子裡跑了好幾個小時。

root.note: 內在有做工的能量 → 精力充沛的

senses.en: to cause someone to feel drained of energy; to weaken

ex.en: The long, humid summer tends to enervate everyone in the city.
ex.zh: 漫長潮濕的夏天常讓城裡每個人都無精打采。

root.note: 把筋骨抽掉 → 使衰弱

mn: 陷阱字：enervate 不是「使充滿活力」，而是相反的「使衰弱」。

senses.en: to make someone or something weak

ex.en: Years of poor diet can enfeeble the body.
ex.zh: 多年的不良飲食會使身體衰弱。

root.note: 使虛弱
